name: bettermemory
description: Memory you can verify, between Claude Code and its own past: every retrieved fact carries a staleness verdict checked against the filesystem and git, every use an attribution, and a signed store that shows how each record arrived. Retrieval is opt-in at the tool surface; three hooks add the session brief at session start, up to three pointers per prompt, turn-end settlement, and session capture by the model in the session, off by default.
